name: Zinnia Princino Eines Reste
original_name: ジーニア・プリンシーノ・アイネス＝レステ
source: The somewhat short-tempered and overly straightforward princess of the kingdom.  She is technically the proper successor but has yet to meet the conditions to take the throne.  She is good-hearted by nature, but she doesn't have a good conceptualization of what the costs of her ideas (which aren't necessarily bad in and of themselves) will be.
